61_ask_long_approval_dark.note: A long shell command wrapped across lines rather than ellipsized, because approving what you cannot read is the risk.

64_ask_wrapped_options_narrow_dark.note: Option labels that wrap at a narrow width: each row gets the height its lines need, the glyph sits beside the FIRST line rather than through the second, and the scroll body absorbs what is left over.

63_ask_unanswerable_backend_dark.note: A backend that cannot resolve: the card says so, both actions are disabled, and the note it draws is the note it reserved -- reserve and draw are one predicate, and this pixel pins that.

62_ask_with_attachment_narrow_dark.note: The card yields exactly the height a staged attachment takes, so Submit stays on screen when the composer grows under it.
